prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on what you need (talking-head vs product demo, social short vs longer video, budget, integrations, languages, level of creative control). Below are top options organized by common use case and why you’d pick each.

Top picks by use case

- Talking-head / AI presenters
  - Synthesia — best-known, high‑quality multilingual AI avatars and studio workflow; great for product explainers, testimonial-style ads, and consistent brand presenters.
  - HeyGen / Movio — cheaper/faster alternatives with similar avatar features (good if you need many quick variations).

- Turn text or long-form into social ads / repurposing
  - Pictory — excellent at converting blog posts/webinars into short social clips with captioning.
  - Lumen5 — blog-to-video templates and storyboarding for social formats.

- Template-driven social ads & stock assets (fast, non‑technical)
  - Canva (Video) — huge template library, easy editing, brand kits; great for small teams.
  - Promo.com / Biteable — optimized templates and stock for social ad formats.

- Advanced generative visuals / creative experimentation
  - Runway — strong for generative/video-editing workflows (inpainting, creative transforms) when you want novel visuals beyond stock footage.

- Enterprise creative optimization & analytics
  - VidMob (and similar creative platforms) — combines ad production with performance analytics and creative testing for scaling campaigns.

- Budget / free / mobile-first
  - CapCut / FlexClip — low-cost mobile/desktop editing with basic AI tools for quick social clips.

How to pick the “best” for you
- Output format: vertical 9:16 or square for Reels/TikTok vs 16:9 for YouTube.
- Creative style: do you need a human presenter, voiceover, product close-ups, or stylized generative visuals?
- Automation vs control: templates and auto-editing are faster; advanced editors let you refine details.
- Languages & voiceovers: check multilingual TTS and lip-synching if you need other languages.
- Integrations: can it export directly to ad platforms or A/B testing tools?
- Budget & scale: some tools are per-video affordable; enterprise tools cost more but include workflows and analytics.

If you tell me:
- platform(s) (TikTok, Meta, YouTube, Snapchat),
- ad style (talking-head, product demo, animated text + footage),
- length and budget,
I’ll recommend the top 2 options for your needs and sketch a 15–30s ad script + storyboard you can generate quickly.
